Source layout¶

Folders¶

The source files are in folders in src/, one folder for each function:

Folder

Contents

src/app/

main.cpp, the command line, the window and the renderer, and all the UI windows (app_*.cpp)

src/common/

Code that all the parts use: the logger, JSON, the sample ring, SI numbers and UI helpers, the build information

src/dsp/

Signal processing for the file viewer: FFT, filters, the waterfall and demodulator engine, region export

src/io/

File input and output: the IQ file reader, the recorder, the WAV writer, the PNG snapshots

src/device/

Live devices: the device interface, the backends and the live engine

src/gpu/

The GPU interface and the CUDA, Metal and stub backends

src/siggen/

The signal generator and its outputs

src/audio/

The audio demodulator, the audio sessions and the sound output

An include names the folder, relative to src/, for example #include "common/log.h". src/ is the only include folder for the project files. src/common/ does not include files from other folders.

Application¶

File

Function

src/app/main.cpp

The table of command-line options, ImGui and ImPlot setup, the event loop

src/app/cli.*

The table-driven command-line parser: it runs the option handlers and makes --help from the same table

src/app/platform_x11.*

The Xlib window, input, clipboard, and GLX or software presentation

src/app/sw_renderer.*

The software rasterizer for ImGui draw data

src/app/app.*

The UI: toolbar, linked plots, parameter panels

src/app/app_menu.cpp

The menu bar, the keyboard help and the About window

src/common/ui_util.*

SI-unit inputs and formatters, the scrollbar widget, forms, the gear button, the color bar, the style

src/common/log.*

The logger

src/common/build_info.h

The git commit and version tag. cmake/build_info.cmake writes the definitions at each build

src/common/json.*

The JSON module: a small reader (chain files, SigMF metadata) and the writer functions jsonQuote and jsonNumber

src/io/snapshot.*, src/app/app_snapshot.cpp

Plot snapshots: names, crop, PNG writer, the snapshot window and the capture

File viewer and signal processing¶

File

Function

src/dsp/engine.*

Worker threads, and the waterfall, channel filter, demodulator and overview calculations

src/dsp/dsp.*

FFT (Accelerate vDSP on macOS), windows, FIR design, parallel-for, smoothing

src/io/iq_file.*

The memory-mapped reader for all sample formats, and SigMF and file name detection

src/dsp/extract.*

Region export: checks, filter design, the background job

src/app/app_export.cpp

The export window, the waterfall right-click menu, region selection

src/dsp/measure.*, src/app/app_measure.cpp

Point measurements: the nearest sample, the snap to a peak, the P1 and P2 markers and their differences

GPU¶

File

Function

src/gpu/gpu.h, src/gpu/gpu_common.cpp

The GPU interface, the --gpu rules, the fallback to the CPU

src/gpu/gpu_backend.h

The backend interface

src/gpu/gpu_cuda.cu

The CUDA backend: device setup, waterfall and live spectrum kernels with cuFFT

src/gpu/gpu_metal.mm

The Metal backend: device setup, one-pass FFT kernels, MPSGraph FFT, channel filter

src/gpu/gpu_stub.cpp

The backend for builds without a GPU

Live devices¶

File

Function

src/app/app_live.cpp

The live mode UI: device and recording toolbar, live spectrum, scrolling waterfall

src/device/live.*

The live engine: the device, the sample ring, the recorder and the spectrum thread

src/common/sample_ring.h

The ring buffer between the device thread, the spectrum thread and the recorder

src/io/recorder.*

The SigMF and raw recorder

src/device/sdr_device.*

The device interface, the driver list, sample-rate checks

src/device/sdr_rtlsdr.cpp

The RTL-SDR backend (librtlsdr)

src/device/sdr_uhd.cpp

The USRP backend (UHD C API): all USRP models, one channel at a time

src/device/sdr_bb60.cpp

The Signal Hound BB60 backend (bb_api)

src/device/sdr_skiq.cpp

The Epiq Sidekiq backend (libsidekiq)

src/device/sdr_sim.cpp

The simulated device

src/device/sdr_siggen.cpp

The loopback device that streams the generator into the live view

src/device/sdr_tx.h

The transmitter interface. sdr_uhd.cpp implements it for UHD

Signal generator¶

File

Function

src/siggen/siggen.*

Generator DSP: CW, pulsed, playback and chain waveforms, waveform cache, resampler, checks, chain files, parameter bus

src/siggen/siggen_out.*

Generator outputs: file job, transmit engine, preview

src/app/app_siggen.cpp

The signal generator window

src/app/app_chain.cpp

The Chain section and its preview

Audio¶

File

Function

src/audio/audio_dsp.*

The streaming demodulator: channel filter, AM, FM, SSB, CW, resampler

src/audio/audio_engine.*

Audio sessions (file or live), drift control, WAV recording and export

src/audio/audio_out.*

Sound output (miniaudio) and the ring buffer to the audio callback

src/io/wav_writer.*

The WAV file writer

src/app/app_audio.cpp

The audio window

File

Function

tools/iqgen.cpp

The synthetic test-signal generator

tools/siggen_check.cpp

The self-check for the signal generator

tools/audio_check.cpp

The self-check for the audio demodulator

tools/log_check.cpp

The self-check for the logger

tools/segment_check.cpp

The self-check for the time segment rules

tools/extract_check.cpp

The self-check for the region export

tools/snapshot_check.cpp

The self-check for the plot snapshots

tools/device_check.cpp

The self-check for the device list and the sample rate rules

tools/bb_check.cpp

The self-check for the BB60 backend

tools/bb_sim/

A simulated BB60D behind the bb_api calls that wvt uses

tools/skiq_check.cpp

The self-check for the Sidekiq logic and backend

tools/skiq_sim/

A simulated Sidekiq card behind the libsidekiq calls that wvt uses

tools/gpu_check.cpp

The GPU self-check and benchmark

tools/run-clang-tidy.sh

Runs clang-tidy on the wvt sources, as CI does (.clang-tidy, tools/.clang-tidy)

tools/fuzz/

The libFuzzer targets for the parsers, and their seed inputs in corpus/

Folder

Contents

These pages. docs/design/ has the design records
